title: Retire the 184 baselined T010 hardcoded-UUID findings by migrating integration fixtures to TestHarness.newUuid()
symptom: `tools/lint_test_isolation.py --no-baseline tests/integration` reports BLOCKER=184 T010 hardcoded-UUID findings across 45 files (225 findings total including 11 T020, 6 T030, 22 T050, 2 T060). All 184 are suppressed by tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json, so the C5 gate passes — the violations are recorded debt, not active failures.
root_cause_analysis: Integration test files hand-assign fixed UUID literals for instances, definitions and actors (e.g. 'e5010000-0001-0000-0000-000000000001', 'defdef00-0001-0000-0000-000000000001', 'acac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' in event_store_integration_test.zig, which alone accounts for 59 findings). Two test binaries running concurrently against the same database collide on these rows — the INV-TI-2 failure mode. The canonical remedy already exists: TestHarness.newUuid() / TestHarness.newUuidString(allocator) in tests/integration/helpers.zig, added by ISS-0121 / GH #387 expressly to remove this collision class. The literals predate that helper and were never migrated. Note that a subset are genuine shared system constants (e.g. '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' as the conventional platform-admin actor user_id, 13 occurrences) which must stay fixed and should remain baselined with a recorded reason rather than randomised.
impact: Concurrent or repeated integration runs collide on fixture rows, which is a known contributor to the non-deterministic integration failures tracked in GH #454. The suppression file also grows into a standing 225-entry ledger that must be line-resynced every time test files shift (ISS-0171 / GH #498), creating recurring maintenance and a recurring opportunity to silently baseline a real defect.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 184 T010 findings is either converted to TestHarness.newUuid()/newUuidString() or retained in the baseline with an individual written reason identifying it as a genuine fixed system constant
The baseline shrinks by the number converted and gains no new entries

Every touched integration test still compiles and passes, measured against a pre-change baseline run so that pre-existing failures (#482, #479, #427, #424, #423, #418, #417) are not mistaken for regressions
related: GH #402 — prior partial T010 reduction effort
ISS-0171 / GH #498 — baseline line resync, the recurring maintenance cost
ISS-0152 / GH #484 — this debt is what that issue pointed at
notes: Filed per CLAUDE.md 'No Issue Left Local-Only' and the 'filed and forwarded, not fixed here' scope boundary. This is a large mechanical change across 45 test files that must be validated by actually running the affected suites; bundling it into WF03-ISS-0152-20260807 would have produced an unreviewable diff and risked silent breakage masked by known-red suites.

resolution.note: Closed by WF03-GH512-20260808 Step 5 PASS; 110 UUID sites converted to TestHarness.newUuid()/newUuidString(allocator); 51 sites marked RETAIN with comment per design §R1/R2/R3; 1 design-mandated RETAIN added in commit 22ac3fc0 (GH-512 platform-admin UUID substring-search target).
